g.text: Fox completes its $22B acquisition of Roku ◆ Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO ◆ After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop ◆ Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo ◆ Physicl raises $10M to make the digital world real enough for robots ◆ Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck in 2027 ◆
